goal:
Solve this ChessBench tactical puzzle using the offline strict sequence variant (not interactive official puzzle accuracy). The opponent's setup move has already been applied.

Position (FEN): 5rk1/1R3p1p/p5p1/5n2/PPQ1p3/4P3/3q1PPP/2R3K1 b - - 2 29

Submit the solver's moves as space-separated UCI moves, for example `e2e4 g1f3`. Do not include opponent moves. Every applied move must be legal; a legal immediate checkmate ends the puzzle. Unused trailing tokens are ignored.
